text: Verified production-kernel streaming on JVM and Scala.js: scan/run parity is green; pair objective and motion application no longer allocate intermediate sampled outputs. Shared adversarial evidence now proves fixed-domain loss cannot improve by dropping hard voxels, physical translation recovery is invariant across oblique/permuted/reflected grids, and asymmetric full-affine translation plus four-degree rotation application reproduces an analytic linear field. JVM receipt (20 measured repetitions, warmup 5, deterministic/concurrent checks): pair 9,261 voxels, 1,292,936 B allocation, 1,105,560 B observed peak delta, median 11,940,417 ns, p95 12,191,500 ns, 38.004 MVox/s; application 147,456 samples, 2,371,488 B allocation for 2,359,296 B payload, 4,194,304 B observed peak delta, median 2,891,125 ns, p95 3,583,459 ns, 51.003 MSamples/s. Revision is honestly recorded as uncommitted-worktree, not release evidence.
